crossRefs.note: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die…
Yahweh says, “Record this man as childless, a man who will not prosper in his days; for no more will a man of his…

parallels.note: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

translations.web: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.
translations.bsb: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a wife but died childless.
translations.kjv: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.
translations.asv: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died childless;
